                pw.println(0);

                            dotProduct += ax[d] * ay[d];
                            mag1 += ax[d] * ax[d];
                            mag2 += ay[d] * ay[d];
                        }
                        
                        double cosAngle = dotProduct / Math.sqrt(mag1 * mag2);
                        double angleDeg = Math.toDegrees(Math.acos(cosAngle));

                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (badIndices.contains(i)) break;

            }

                if (!badIndices.contains(i)) {
                    pw.println(i);
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new RuntimeException(e);
        }
    }
}
